en: A multi-image postcard featuring Secu Monastery and its ecclesiastical treasures. The central photo shows the fortified Romanian Orthodox monastery complex with white church walls and conical towers against forested hills. Surrounding images display a carved cross, a gilded gospel cover with medallions, silver censers and chandeliers, and an embroidered epitaph. The front title reads "MÎNĂSTIREA SECU." The back lists the depicted items in Romanian, French, German, and English and credits the Metropolis of Moldavia and Suceava in Iași.
